punchline: In 1987 61.1 percent of workers were satisfied; by 2010, only 45.
thirty_sec: The Conference Board's January 2010 survey of about 5,000 households found 45 percent of US workers satisfied with their jobs, against 61.1 percent in 1987, and the decline had continued through booms and busts.
